method: Generic deterministic equilibrium-start solver (domain=cube, dim=2, symmetry=none) with fold-free geodesic-accelerated Cholesky LM, smooth boundary hinge pull, and minimum-norm Gauss-Newton end-stage; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Antigravity (AI-assisted)
